4. Chat or voice call system using libraries like Twilio or Socket.io.
5. Recommendation algorithm using machine learning libraries like scikit-learn or TensorFlow.

This software will provide a comprehensive virtual audio book club experience, allowing users to join book clubs, discuss books, and receive personalized recommendations.
